name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Customer Success Manager | Retention, Expansion & NRR for B2B SaaS
summary: Customer success and account management professional with 15+ years in B2B SaaS, owning the post-sale journey from onboarding and adoption through retention and expansion. Retained ~94% of a 15-20 partner book at Birdeye, held 120% of sales targets at Wix, and ranked top three in sales at Accelo while quota roughly doubled. Consultative with operations leaders and C-suite buyers alike, and hands-on building AI agents and workflow automation.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Own the primary relationship for a portfolio of B2B service clients, running discovery to surface business goals and mapping the platform setup to those goals.
Expand retainer scope by identifying and recommending complementary services aligned with each client's objectives.
Architect and deploy AI agents and automated workflows in GoHighLevel, Zapier, Make, and n8n that replace manual operational steps end to end.
Report performance on a regular cadence with actionable insights and recommendations, tracking every interaction in the CRM.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Managed multi-stakeholder accounts, translating performance data into strategic recommendations delivered in QBRs.
Resolved client feedback promptly and held delivery quality consistent to protect satisfaction and retention.

experience.title: Customer Success & Retention (Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding)
bullets: Onboarded and managed 15-20 reseller partners (deal sizes ~$10K-$45K, spanning health, home services, and retail), retaining all but one (~94% retention) during tenure.
Analyzed partner utilization and performance metrics in Salesforce to identify adoption gaps and intervene before they became churn.
Advised partners on retention strategy and customer health metrics, equipping them to communicate product value to their own customers.
Shared structured, high-priority customer feedback with Product and Engineering to inform the roadmap.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Closed 6 new-client deals averaging ~$22K each (~$130K+ in total bookings) and led the sales team alongside an individual book.
Served a banking-industry client and helped pursue a major banking prospect in the northeastern U.S., reaching finalist stage.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Onboarded and launched 25+ clients per month, holding 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets.
Managed a high-value account portfolio across diverse verticals, driving a 25% improvement in conversion rates across supported e-commerce accounts.
Led and developed a team of onboarding specialists for 2 years (20, later 8), and drove process improvements for a new vertical that went from proof of concept to a profitable business line.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Ranked top three in sales on a team that scaled from 8 to 15 reps while quota roughly doubled, averaging ~$17,750/month in implementation and services bookings (~$213K annualized) plus new recurring revenue.
Built trusted-advisor relationships with C-suite executives at agencies and professional-services firms, guiding onboarding and operational workflow design.
Escalated account risk to leadership early and resolved it with direct strategic guidance.
